items.title:
se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-annotations 1.0.0-RC6 发布, VibeTags annotation classes (@AILocked, @AIContext, @AIDraft, @AIAudit,
        @AIIgnore, @AIPrivacy, @AICore, @AIPerformance). Zero third-party dependencies.
        All annotations use RetentionPolicy.SOURCE so they leave no trace in the
        consumer's compiled bytecode — this jar exists purely to give javac the
        symbols it needs at compile time.

        Pair this with vibetags-processor on the annotation-processor classpath:

        Maven:
            <dependency>
                <groupId>se.deversity.vibetags</groupId>
                <artifactId>vibetags-annotations</artifactId>
                <version>1.0.0-RC6</version>
            </dependency>

        Gradle:
            compileOnly 'se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-annotations:1.0.0-RC6'
            annotationProcessor 'se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-processor:1.0.0-RC6'

de.focus-shift:jollyday 2.18.0 发布, This API determines the holidays for a given year, country/name and eventually state/region. The holiday data is
    stored in XML files (one for each country) and will be read from the classpath. You can provide your own holiday
    calendar XML file or use any of the provided ones.

    Currently, there are over 230 countries supported like the following:
    * United States
    * Germany
    * France
    * India
    * Australia
    * and so on

    Besides, those there will be more special calendars like currently existing NYSE calendar (New York Stock Exchange).

        _includes.adoc emission. Source-specific parsers (FHIR NPM

        corpus project's own ingest module and consume this library.
